description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0025 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). RSS / Atom / JSON Feed to clean JSON: give a feed URL (or a web page that links one, auto-discovered) and get feed title/link/language plus normalised items: id, title, link, ISO dates, author, plain-text summary, categories, enclosures (podcast audio, media), image. Filter with since= and limit=; include_content=true adds the full text. When to use: Use feed-json to read an RSS/Atom/JSON feed (or find the feed of a site) as clean JSON items, e.g. to watch a blog, changelog, podcast or news source. Use page-rag for the full text of one article page.

include_content.description: true adds content_text (full text, HTML stripped, max 20,000 chars per item)

since.description: only items published at/after this ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-01

summary_chars.description: max summary length, 0-2000, default 400 (0 omits it)

url.description: feed URL (RSS 0.9x/1.0/2.0, Atom, JSON Feed) or a page with <link rel="alternate"> to one

name: feed_json

outputSchema.description: Inferred from a real response captured on 2026-10-26; extra fields may appear, null-valued fields are untyped.
